behavior.name: Keep Your Distance
behavior.program:
# Example: change one condition and predict the result.
# A ranged enemy keeps space, then uses its attacks.
let preferred_range = 190
let retreat_range = 120
if distance > preferred_range
  move chase
elif distance < retreat_range
  move retreat
else
  move orbit
end
if distance < 350
  use primary
end
if health < 40
  guard on
  use secondary
  use special
end
